facts.fact: The SNDI training centre, under the digital transition ministry, says it has trained more than 37,500 civil servants and state agents in IT since it opened on 10 September 2012.

facts.fact: 192 civil servants from 35 structures in the Hambol region received certificates on 29 July 2026 after an SNDI course in IT and AI run from 22 June.
